title.zh: Prime Intellect推理平台上线：内部每天已跑近1万亿Token
title.en: Prime Intellect推理平台上线：内部每天已跑近1万亿Token

current_state.zh: Prime Intellect launched Prime Inference, an OpenAI-compatible model inference service that already handles roughly 1 trillion tokens per day internally, debuting with GLM-5.3 and featuring latency and KV-cache optimizations tuned for long-context agent workloads.
